phoneSetPassText: At least 4 characters. It never leaves this device — and there is no way to recover it if forgotten, only to erase the journal and start over.
phoneFooter: Foundations plan by Replicate Ministries (replicate.org). Progress and journal entries are saved on this device; the journal is encrypted with your passcode. Use Settings → Backup now and then so it isn’t lost with the device.

ipadBeforeErase.hint: Journal is locked. Open any HEAR panel or the Journal tab to unlock.

eraseDialog.title: Erase the whole journal?
eraseDialog.text: Every HEAR entry and the passcode will be deleted from this device. Reading progress stays. This can’t be undone — copy anything you want to keep first.

ipadAfterErase: No passcode yet — you’ll be asked to set one the first time you open a HEAR panel.

phoneOpenAfterErase.hint: Journal is unlocked. It locks again whenever the app is reopened.

phoneReopened.hint: No passcode yet — you’ll be asked to set one the first time you open a HEAR panel.
